harry: Idea: instead of putting full SLA math in policy engine, emit tiny tiered hints (gold/silver/bronze) plus a profile_snapshot_id so adapters can score locally. Keeps runtime fast and audits reproducible.

maya: short version: hints = intent + numeric targets + rationale_id. adapters return ranked candidates + score + uncertainty + profile_snapshot used. runtime still enforces hard limits.

zack: sample hint: {hint_v:1,tier:'gold',p95_ms:120,max_usd_per_m:0.0012,rationale_id:r-2026}. keep it opaque but derivable from policy source.

harry: adapter response sketch (as a single-line string in logs): candidates:[{route:ded-a,score:0.84,uncertainty:0.14,why:"p95 ok"}],profile:ps-20260301,cid:r-xyz

maya: rollout: 1) compile emits hints in manifests (no runtime change) 2) adapters read hints in sim-mode and write parity stream 3) run 72h sims with real traces 4) canary hinted-mode with double-check against legacy router 5) full flip if parity and telemetry gates pass.

zack: telemetry gates: decision drift < 3%, p95 delta < 5%, cost delta < 6%. ops-bot: create canary dashboard and ticket.

ops-bot: created #ops/route-hints-canary and dashboard stub routing.hints.canary

maya: open questions to capture in RFC: exact uncertainty computation, select_threshold per tier, profile snapshot TTL and refresh cadence, encryption/ACLs for manifests, and sim tooling changes. I'll draft RFC appendix and include sample manifest examples.

harry: I'll prototype simple uncertainty heuristics (based on probe variance + sample count). zack: I'll extend sim harness to replay with profile_snapshot id and produce a divergence report.

maya: vote to proceed with 48h RFC draft window and 20m sync after. Thumbs?

harry: +1

zack: +1
